rows.label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
rows.value: The 2025 increases (0.50 point up to €15,000 and 1.79 points from €15,000 to €28,000) do not apply to taxpayers with taxable income up to €28,000; €150 credit for taxable income from €28,001 to €50,000. No refund.
